marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to west 15 knots late this evening and to
west 20 late overnight. Wind diminishing to west 15 Wednesday
afternoon. Scattered flurries. Risk of freezing drizzle late this
morning. Fog patches forming late this evening and dissipating Wednesday
morning. Temperatures minus 6 rising to minus 1 Wednesday
morning. <br/>
